svg.title: From an objective landscape to one step along a direction
svg.desc: A translucent three-dimensional loss surface is cut along the optimizer direction. Its green cross-section becomes the same green loss curve in the two-dimensional plot. Two rust-colored probes near the current point fit a dashed local model. A gray diamond marks the base optimizer step; a purple point marks the ZFO model-selected step. Heights on the surface show actual loss, which can differ from the model. Synthetic illustration.
